description: This file defines the utility class `GeoLocationUtils` which provides a static method to retrieve the client's IP address from an HTTP request by checking various headers that may contain the forwarded IP, typically used behind proxies or load balancers.

classes.name: GeoLocationUtils
classes.description: A utility class for extracting client's IP address from HTTP requests by inspecting various headers that may contain forwarded IPs.

methods.name: getClientIpAddress
methods.description: Returns the client's IP address from the HTTP request by checking multiple headers and falling back to remote address if necessary.
